from scipy.stats import wilcoxon

freqs = np.arange(8., 13., 1.)  # 8-12 Hz
n_cycles = 5.  # cycles for Morlet
suppression_pct = 0.2  # threshold for 20% decrease

# 1. Load MEG data and events for session 5

evt_file = 'sub-0_ses-5_events.tsv'

    data = f['data'][:]  # (306, n_samples)
    times = f['times'][:]  # (n_samples,)
    ch_names = [name.strip() for name in f.attrs['channel_names'].split(',')]
    sfreq = float(f.attrs['sample_frequency'])

# 2. Define frontal and occipital channels

occipital_idx = [i for i, ch in enumerate(ch_names) if ch[3:5] == '06']
print(f"# Frontal channels: {len(frontal_idx)}; Occipital channels: {len(occipital_idx)}")

words = df[df['kind'] == 'word']
times_meg = words['timemeg'].values
t_sample = np.searchsorted(times, times_meg)

n_pre = int(abs(tmin) * sfreq)
n_post = int(tmax * sfreq)
n_times = n_pre + n_post
epoch_times = np.linspace(tmin, tmax, n_times, endpoint=False)

# Collect and baseline-correct epochs
epochs = []
for idx in t_sample:
    start = idx - n_pre
    stop = idx + n_post
    if start < 0 or stop > data.shape[1]:
        continue
    epoch = data[:, start:stop]
    epoch = epoch - epoch[:, :n_pre].mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    epochs.append(epoch)
epochs = np.stack(epochs)
n_epochs = epochs.shape[0]
print(f"# Retained epochs: {n_epochs}")

# 5. Pad epochs to fit wavelet length
wavelet_len = int(np.ceil(n_cycles / freqs.min() * sfreq))
pad = wavelet_len

        post = power[ei, ci, n_pre:]

lat_o = np.nanmean(onset[:, occipital_idx], axis=1)

{"code":"import numpy as np
import h5py
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from mne.time_frequency import tfr_array_morlet
from scipy.stats import wilcoxon

# Parameters
tmin, tmax = -0.2, 0.6  # seconds
freqs = np.arange(8., 13., 1.)  # 8-12 Hz
n_cycles = 5.  # cycles for Morlet
suppression_pct = 0.2  # threshold for 20% decrease

# 1. Load MEG data and events for session 5
meg_file = 'sub-0_ses-5_meg.h5'
evt_file = 'sub-0_ses-5_events.tsv'
with h5py.File(meg_file, 'r') as f:
    data = f['data'][:]  # (306, n_samples)
    times = f['times'][:]  # (n_samples,)
    ch_names = [name.strip() for name in f.attrs['channel_names'].split(',')]
    sfreq = float(f.attrs['sample_frequency'])

# 2. Define frontal and occipital channels
frontal_idx = [i for i, ch in enumerate(ch_names) if ch[3:5] == '02']
occipital_idx = [i for i, ch in enumerate(ch_names) if ch[3:5] == '06']
print(f"# Frontal channels: {len(frontal_idx)}; Occipital channels: {len(occipital_idx)}")

# 3. Load events and get word onsets
df = pd.read_csv(evt_file, sep='\t')
words = df[df['kind'] == 'word']
times_meg = words['timemeg'].values
t_sample = np.searchsorted(times, times_meg)

# 4. Epoching
n_pre = int(abs(tmin) * sfreq)
n_post = int(tmax * sfreq)
n_times = n_pre + n_post
epoch_times = np.linspace(tmin, tmax, n_times, endpoint=False)

# Collect and baseline-correct epochs
epochs = []
for idx in t_sample:
    start = idx - n_pre
    stop = idx + n_post
    if start < 0 or stop > data.shape[1]:
        continue
    epoch = data[:, start:stop]
    epoch = epoch - epoch[:, :n_pre].mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    epochs.append(epoch)
epochs = np.stack(epochs)
n_epochs = epochs.shape[0]
print(f"# Retained epochs: {n_epochs}")

# 5. Pad epochs to fit wavelet length
wavelet_len = int(np.ceil(n_cycles / freqs.min() * sfreq))
pad = wavelet_len
epochs_padded = np.pad(epochs, ((0,0),(0,0),(pad,pad)), mode='constant')

# 6. Compute induced power (Morlet)
tfr = tfr_array_morlet(epochs_padded, sfreq=sfreq,
                       freqs=freqs, n_cycles=n_cycles, output='power')
power = tfr[..., pad:pad+n_times].mean(axis=2)  # shape: (n_epochs, n_ch, n_times)

# 7. Detect alpha-suppression onset per epoch and channel
onset = np.full((n_epochs, power.shape[1]), np.nan)
for ei in range(n_epochs):
    for ci in range(power.shape[1]):
        baseline = power[ei, ci, :n_pre]
        thresh = baseline.mean() * (1 - suppression_pct)
        post = power[ei, ci, n_pre:]
        below = np.where(post < thresh)[0]
        if below.size > 0:
            onset[ei, ci] = epoch_times[n_pre + below[0]]

# 8. Compute region-wise latencies per epoch
lat_f = np.nanmean(onset[:, frontal_idx], axis=1)
lat_o = np.nanmean(onset[:, occipital_idx], axis=1)
print(f"# Epochs with valid frontal latency: {(~np.isnan(lat_f)).sum()}/{n_epochs}")
print(f"# Epochs with valid occipital latency: {(~np.isnan(lat_o)).sum()}/{n_epochs}")

# 9. Wilcoxon test on paired latencies (exclude NaNs)
mask = ~np.isnan(lat_f) & ~np.isnan(lat_o)
stat, pval = wilcoxon(lat_f[mask], lat_o[mask])
print(f"Wilcoxon signed-rank: stat={stat:.3f}, p={pval:.3e}")

# 10. Boxplot of onset latencies
data_plot = [lat_f[mask], lat_o[mask]]
plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
plt.boxplot(data_plot, positions=[1,2], labels=['Frontal','Occipital'])
plt.ylabel('Alpha suppression onset (s)')
plt.title('Onset Latencies of Alpha Suppression')
plt.show()

# 11. Latency summary
def summarize(arr):
    med = np.nanmedian(arr)
    iqr = np.nanpercentile(arr, [25,75])
    return med, iqr[0], iqr[1]
med_f, q1_f, q3_f = summarize(lat_f[mask])
med_o, q1_o, q3_o = summarize(lat_o[mask])
print("Latency summary (median [IQR]):")
print(f"Frontal:   {med_f:.3f}s [{q1_f:.3f}, {q3_f:.3f}]")
print(f"Occipital: {med_o:.3f}s [{q1_o:.3f}, {q3_o:.3f}]")"}
